what: Buyer reports finding Etsy sellers more honest than eBay sellers; finds unusual high-quality items not available elsewhere; when a recent purchase did not arrive, both Etsy and the seller provided a refund to credit card in 48 hours and 30 minutes; buyer prefers Etsy despite some dishonest sellers.
verbatim_snippet: "I find most Etsy sellers to be very honest and helpful. I can find very unusual and high-quality items not available elsewhere. The site is sometimes challenging to navigate, but worth the effort. Sure, there are some dishonest sellers, but I find Etsy sellers far more honest than those on eBay. Also when a recent purchase did not arrive both Etsy and the seller got a refund to my credit card in 48 hours, 30 minutes. That is why I prefer Etsy."
notes: ConsumerAffairs page returned 403 on direct fetch; verbatim from search index. Explicit buyer comparison: Etsy vs eBay (favors Etsy for seller honesty). Refund speed: 48 hours 30 minutes. UX criticism: site navigation is challenging.
